name: County Connection: LINK Paratransit
description: Door-to-door transit in Central Contra Costa County
fullDescription: LINK is County Connection's ADA paratransit service for Central Contra Costa County residents who cannot use regular bus service due to a disability.
whatTheyOffer:
- Door-to-door shared ride service
- Serves locations within 1.5 miles of a County Connection bus route (or 3/4 mile of BART when buses aren't running)
- Reservations 1-7 days in advance
- $5 per person each way
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
- Personal care attendants ride free
howToGetIt:
1. Complete the LINK eligibility and registration form
2. Application at countyconnection.com/paratransit
3. An assessment may be required
4. Once registered, book rides by calling 925-938-RIDE (7433)
keywords: LINK, County Connection, paratransit, ADA, Contra Costa, Walnut Creek, Concord, disability, wheelchair
